title: Grymskull Helm
summary: Heavy Armour headwear. Resist Fire damage, avoid critical hits, and cast Hunter’s Mark.

fields.Defence: While worn, you resist Fire. Incoming attacks cannot score critical hits against you. Heavy Armour training applies.
fields.Hunter’s Mark: The armour grant lists an Action once per Long Rest. Mark a creature at up to 60 ft. Concentrate until Long Rest. Your weapon hits deal 1d6 extra damage of the weapon’s type. Unarmed hits do not qualify.
fields.Reapply: When the mark dies, use a Bonus Action to shift it to another creature without a slot while concentration continues.
fields.Reported behavior: Unequipping the helm after casting can leave access to the spell until Long Rest or the end of concentration.
fields.Acquisition: Loot Grym at the Adamantine Forge.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
